name: Thunderous Bellow (Recharge 5–6)
description: The creature bellows in a 60 foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 54 (12d8) thunder damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away from the creature and knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn’t pushed or knocked prone.
